proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL barkara gives regional bakarā/bakrā and feminine bakarī/bakrī goat, plus Garhwali/Kumaoni/Nepali bākhro with aspiration. Selected Tharu bakariya-type responses retain the ordinary expanded feminine ending, and Kului a/schwa plus retroflex-r forms retain their exact articulation and vowel notation. This is the barkara family; rounded forms overlapping bokka are excluded. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: bʌkʌɾija.
